paras: Gekko horsfieldii, also known commonly as Horsfield's flying gecko, Horsfield's gliding gecko, and Horsfield's parachute gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Asia.
The specific name, horsfieldii, is in honor of American naturalist Thomas Horsfield.
G. horsfieldii is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Sarawak, Singapore, Sumatra, and Thailand.
The preferred natural habitat of G. horsfieldii is forest, at altitudes from sea level to 300 m (980 ft).
G. horsfieldii may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 8 cm (3.1 in).
G. horsfieldii preys upon small insects.
G. horsfieldii is oviparous. The adult female lays a clutch of two eggs. Each egg measures 13.7 by 11.9 mm (0.54 by 0.47 in).
